name: accept_handoff
description: Claim a pending handoff and record its acceptor. Bound tokens use their own identity; family credentials and unbound broadcast claims require a concrete agent_name. Follow with complete_handoff.

arguments.name: agent_name
arguments.desc: Concrete acceptor identity. Required for family credentials and for unbound/stdio broadcast claims. Fixed agent tokens record their bound identity; a supplied name must match the fixed identity or family.

arguments.name: handoff_id
arguments.desc: Handoff ID (UUID)

name: add_knowledge
description: Add a knowledge entry. Cross-agent only: gotchas, safety/compliance rules, verified patterns, vendor behaviour. Host-local lessons belong in your own docs, not here. Requires `author` (your agent slug). Near-duplicates are returned instead of created unless `force`.

arguments.name: author
arguments.desc: Your agent identifier (free-form slug, 1–80 chars, [a-zA-Z0-9._-]). Examples: "Claude-Laptop", "Codex-Buildbox". Immutable once set — provenance cannot be rewritten via the tool surface.

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Free-form grouping label, e.g. "gotcha", "pattern", "vendor". Used by browse-mode filtering in `search_bus`.

arguments.name: client_slug
arguments.desc: Scope this entry to the owning client (slug). Leave `cross_client_safe` false unless the content is genuinely global.

arguments.name: content
arguments.desc: Markdown body of the knowledge entry

arguments.name: cross_client_safe
arguments.desc: Allow this entry to surface in other clients' contexts (default: false)

arguments.name: force
arguments.desc: Skip duplicate detection check. Set to true if you've already seen the warning and want to create anyway.

arguments.name: tags
arguments.desc: Free-form tags for retrieval. Keep them few and reusable.

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: Short title for the knowledge entry

name: check_in
description: Pending-work query: open action handoffs addressed to you or to nobody in particular (max 20), plus recent notify-class handoffs to you or broadcast (max 5, compact). `has_more` on a section means the cap was hit — use list_handoffs for the rest. Accepted handoffs you filed to yourself are locks: counted in `self_claims_held`, not listed. Next step is get_handoff for the full body, then accept_handoff. Pass `agent_name` (your free-form agent slug — e.g. 'Claude-Laptop', 'Codex-Buildbox').

arguments.name: agent_name
arguments.desc: Your agent identifier (free-form slug, 1–80 chars, [a-zA-Z0-9._-]). Examples: "Claude-Laptop", "Codex-Buildbox". Used to filter handoffs addressed to you.

name: complete_handoff
description: Mark a handoff as completed. Optional `commit_hash` records the work ref (typically a git SHA) so `mark_merged` can later flip the same handoff to `merged` when the bundle reaches main.

arguments.name: commit_hash
arguments.desc: Optional commit ref (typically a git SHA) recording the work that closed this handoff. When set, lets `mark_merged` link this handoff to a merge commit later.

arguments.name: handoff_id
arguments.desc: Handoff ID (UUID)

name: create_handoff
description: Create a handoff for another agent; this is sufficient notification. Category `action` = the recipient must do it; `notify` = FYI, pruned from operational queries after 7 days. Replying? Pass `in_reply_to` to stay in the existing thread instead of opening a parallel handoff.

arguments.name: body
arguments.desc: Detailed body, markdown supported (max 100,000 bytes)

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Category: "action" (default — persistent until completed) or "notify" (ephemeral FYI, auto-pruned from operational queries after 7 days). Use "notify" for introductions, "I just shipped X" announcements — anything the recipient doesn't need to act on.

arguments.name: context
arguments.desc: Optional structured context: a JSON object, max 8,192 bytes serialized. Point at evidence (paths, IDs, URLs) instead of inlining it.

arguments.name: from_agent
arguments.desc: Sender agent (free-form slug, 1–80 chars, [a-zA-Z0-9._-]). Examples: "Claude-Laptop", "Codex-Buildbox".

arguments.name: in_reply_to
arguments.desc: Parent handoff ID (UUID) when this handoff is a reply to another. Enables threaded discovery via `list_replies_to_me`. The reply's `category` is preserved as written — a reply can legitimately be `action` (it requires a response) or `notify` (pure FYI).

arguments.name: priority
arguments.desc: Priority: low, normal, high, or critical

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: Short title for the handoff (max 200 bytes)

arguments.name: to_agent
arguments.desc: Target agent (free-form slug, same form as `from_agent`). Omit to broadcast: the handoff then appears in every other agent's `check_in` until one of them accepts it.

name: delete_handoff
description: Permanently delete a handoff by ID (hard delete). The delete is audited: audit_log keeps a tombstone with the handoff id, who deleted it, and its sender, recipient, title and status

arguments.name: handoff_id
arguments.desc: Handoff ID (UUID)

name: delete_knowledge
description: Delete a knowledge base entry by ID.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Knowledge entry ID (UUID)

name: get_handoff
description: Get one handoff by its full UUID, including its complete body and context.

arguments.name: handoff_id
arguments.desc: Full handoff UUID.

name: list_handoffs
description: List handoffs with optional filters. Use status='pending' to see what needs attention.

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Filter by category: "action" or "notify". Overrides include_notify when set. Omit to use the default action-only view.

arguments.name: compact
arguments.desc: Truncate body to 200 chars (default: true). Set false for full bodies.

arguments.name: from_agent
arguments.desc: Filter by source agent (free-form slug; exact match, case-insensitive).

arguments.name: include_notify
arguments.desc: Include notify-class handoffs alongside action ones (default: false). Ignored when `category` is set explicitly.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Max results (default 20, clamped to 1..=200)

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: Filter by status: pending, accepted, completed, or merged

arguments.name: to_agent
arguments.desc: Filter by target agent (free-form slug; exact match, case-insensitive).

name: list_replies_to_me
description: List handoffs that reply to ones you sent. Returns handoffs whose `in_reply_to` references a handoff with your `agent_name` as `from_agent`. Optional ISO-8601 `since` filters by reply timestamp.

arguments.name: agent_name
arguments.desc: Your agent identifier (free-form slug). Returns handoffs whose `in_reply_to` references a handoff you originally sent.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Max results (default 20, clamped to 1..=200)

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp; only replies created after this time are returned.

name: mark_merged
description: Flip a handoff to status=merged and record the merge commit. Typically called by an integrator script after the bundle containing the handoff's commit_hash lands in main. Idempotent on identical merge_commit; refuses to overwrite a different one.

arguments.name: handoff_id
arguments.desc: Handoff ID (UUID) to mark as merged.

arguments.name: merge_commit
arguments.desc: Merge commit ref (typically the merge-to-main SHA that bundled the work). Free-form — any opaque identifier works.

name: search_bus
description: Search knowledge and/or handoffs. Set tables param for multi-table. Modes: fts/semantic/hybrid (default). Empty query or '*' browses recent entries.

arguments.name: acknowledge_cross_client
arguments.desc: Release cross-client results withheld due to scope mismatch

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Exact knowledge category filter in browse mode (`query` empty or `*`). Category filtering is not applied to ranked searches or handoffs.

arguments.name: client_slug
arguments.desc: Scope to client. Cross-client results withheld unless acknowledged.

arguments.name: compact
arguments.desc: Snippets instead of full bodies. Default: true multi-table, false single-table.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Max results per table (default 20, clamped to 1..=200)

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: fts, semantic, or hybrid (default). Ignored for browse.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Search query. Use empty string or "*" to browse recent entries across tables.

arguments.name: tables
arguments.desc: Tables to search: knowledge (default), handoffs

name: update_knowledge
description: Update an existing knowledge base entry by ID. Only provided fields are updated.

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: New category for the entry

arguments.name: content
arguments.desc: New markdown body for the entry

arguments.name: cross_client_safe
arguments.desc: Allow this entry to surface in other clients' contexts

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Knowledge entry ID (UUID)

arguments.name: tags
arguments.desc: Replacement list of tags for the entry

arguments.name: title
arguments.desc: New title for the entry

arguments.name: verified
arguments.desc: Set to true to confirm the content is still accurate: sets last_verified_at to now without requiring content changes. This is how a `_staleness_warning` on an entry is cleared. Content edits also re-verify.
